title: In the Bishop's Carriage
author: Miriam Michelson
description: "In the Bishop's Carriage" by Miriam Michelson is a novel written during the late 19th century.
longDescription: The story introduces us to Nancy Olden, a spirited young woman who finds herself embroiled in a series of misadventures in a city teeming with opportunity and mischief. The narrative promises a blend of humor, social commentary, and a touch of romance as Nancy navigates through her escapades.

authorInfo.bio: Miriam Michelson (1870–1942) is the author of In the Bishop's Carriage. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
